desc:
✏️ Flick your pen and knock your rival off the desk in fast 1v1 and 2v2 battles!

Drag back, aim and let go. Flick the middle of your pen to push straight, or an end to spin it. Use too much power and your own pen flies off too!

🐉 NEW: collect 24 pen skins, each with its own effects!
⚔️ Challenge friends or players from around the world
🎮 4 ways to play: take turns or shoot together, for rounds or points
🤖 Practice against an AI that gets tougher as you win
🪑 Win Lucky Blocks and buy rare chairs
🔥 Build your win streak and climb the leaderboards
😹 Tease your rival with cat reactions
🎁 Claim daily rewards and spin the wheel

👍 Like the game and join the group for a free Lucky Block card!
